# Thrasher Foundation Repair

> > Family-owned foundation repair, basement waterproofing, concrete leveling, and crawl space encapsulation company serving the Midwest since 1975.

Thrasher Foundation Repair provides comprehensive structural repair solutions across Nebraska, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Illinois, and Colorado. Founded by Greg and Nancy Thrasher, the company specializes in foundation piering, wall stabilization, sump pump systems, PolyLevel concrete lifting, and crawl space moisture control.

## Key Topics

- Foundation Repair & Piering
- Basement Waterproofing
- Concrete Leveling (PolyLevel)
- Crawl Space Encapsulation
- Sump Pump Systems (TripleSafe, SmartSump)
- Foundation Settlement Solutions
- Wall Stabilization & Crack Repair
- NexusPro Concrete Caulking
- Humidity Control & Mold Prevention
- Polyaspartic Concrete Coating
- EverBrace Wall System
- RainDrop Gutter Guards
- Service Areas: Omaha, Kansas City, Wichita, Denver, Des Moines
- Family Business Since 1975
